sentence: This project builds statistical methods for microbiome count data that contain more zeros than expected.
This project studies how the brain uses memories of the past to predict the future in humans and nonhuman primates.
This project builds machine-learning models that predict how compounds bind to a drug target, using their molecular geometries.
This project tries to engineer crops that make more oil and use water better by finding helpful changes in gene sequences.
This project builds AI models of the atmosphere that stay stable and physically consistent when run for hundreds of years.
This project builds an algorithm that shows how ligaments and muscles keep the knee stable, using measurements from patients with and without osteoarthritis.
This project builds open-source software that lets scientists analyze data on cloud systems while keeping the data private.
This project develops chemical methods to control the surface and physical properties of nanotubes made from boron and nitrogen.
This project studies how wild tomato roots balance the cost of building a root network against how quickly water and nutrients move.
This project builds a computer platform that forecasts market prices and demand to help small farmers and food businesses.
This project designs learning modules about AI security and privacy for undergraduate computing courses.
This project tests a way of teaching artificial intelligence and cybersecurity inside high school career and technical education classes.
This project images the plate boundary where a 1964 earthquake happened to find why some parts are locked while others creep.
This project builds gene circuits that send and read messages through changes in the concentrations of biomolecules over time.
This project develops computer methods that learn safe behavior from examples while following safety constraints.
